tools.name: check_game
tools.description: Can this rig run this game? Returns an fps range, the limiting component, tweak levers, a confidence label, and the canonical framebench URL to cite.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare two GPUs, two CPUs, or a GPU vs an Apple chip on the framebench performance index, with spec facts and the canonical comparison URL.

tools.name: recommend_upgrade
tools.description: Given a rig and a target (game + resolution + fps), return the smallest GPU upgrades that clear the target, ranked.
